detailed_descriptions.en: Burg Tag is a competitive tag game built around the chase. MASTER THE MOVEMENT Both roles have access to the same movement set to make chases more exciting with certain powerups unlocking new ways to get around! Wall Kicks, Monkey Bars, Sliding, Sprinting are all essential moves to evade your opponents. HIDERS! KEEP MOVING... Or Hide! Every round is a choice: trust your hiding spot with your life, or stay on the move. Slide, wall kick, swing and roll your way out of trouble when a Seeker gets too close. SEEKERS! Play Smart! Being “It” shouldn’t be boring. In "Tag", once a hider is caught they join you, doubling the chance of catching someone. Work together to corner, or cut off a hider in a chase. TIME TRIALS Jump into any map solo and try to collect 10 bananas as fast as possible. Originally an afterthought, Time Trials have become one of the most addicting modes in Burg Tag.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Burg Tag is a competitive tag game built around the chase. 

MASTER THE MOVEMENT

Both roles have access to the same movement set to make chases more exciting with certain powerups unlocking new ways to get around! Wall Kicks, Monkey Bars, Sliding, Sprinting are all essential moves to evade your opponents.

HIDERS! KEEP MOVING... Or Hide!

Every round is a choice: trust your hiding spot with your life, or stay on the move. Slide, wall kick, swing and roll your way out of trouble when a Seeker gets too close.

SEEKERS! Play Smart!

Being “It” shouldn’t be boring. In "Tag", once a hider is caught they join you, doubling the chance of catching someone. Work together to corner, or cut off a hider in a chase. 

TIME TRIALS

Jump into any map solo and try to collect 10 bananas as fast as possible. Originally an afterthought, Time Trials have become one of the most addicting modes in Burg Tag.
